text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond's debut race has garnered attention from its reputation as the "500-Million-Point Battle."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Before their debut, Umamusume are scored with RKST points. This particular race is between racers who have accumulated a large amount of points.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Accustomed to the attention, Satono Diamond heads for her debut race without a trace of concern!
